description: North Dakota motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A North Dakota rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The North Dakota age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in North Dakota?
questions.explanation: North Dakota helmet law: riders under 18.

questions.q: What does North Dakota law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: North Dakota: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
